title: Pinned Container Image Reproduction
description: Freezing the entire operating-system image with a content-addressed digest guarantees that the exact same software stack can be rebuilt anywhere. verification: rebuild from digest and compare layer hashes

# Reproduction check: Pinned Container Image Reproduction

                "python": sys.version.split()[0], "platform": platform.system()}
